summary: Verified anonymous /api/public/guides/* PDF endpoints via pytest (5/5 pass). Admin and Student PDFs return 200 application/pdf with %PDF magic bytes, non-empty body, and Content-Disposition filename. Unknown filename returns JSON 404 (not SPA HTML). Path traversal attempts return 404 with no file content leakage (no MONGO_URL / no /etc/passwd content / no %PDF). Certificate verify regression check passes (JSON 404 for bogus code, not 500) confirming shared router/rate-limiter still healthy.
critical_code_review_comments: public_catalog.py: whitelist + FileResponse approach is safe; filename is validated against a set() before os.path.join, so traversal has no surface.
Minor perf nit: consider Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600 on the FileResponse since guides are static assets.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Guides PDF endpoints live and working. Regression coverage for /api/public/certificates/verify included in same test file. Uses per-test X-Test-Client-Ip header to avoid rate-limit bucket collisions.
